---

curate of Hursley

He served as curate of Hursley from 1841, but Bishop Sumner refused to ordain him, so he moved away in 1861 to become Rector of North Witham, Lincolnshire.

He married (20 Oct 1839) Mrs Keble’s ward and cousin Caroline Coxwell.
